dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based open source Japanese medical billing software
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA pattern typical of ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (診療行為チェック・算定 - medical procedure check and calculation for treatment acts, specifically procedures/処置, up to H14.4 revision)
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It performs medical procedure (診療行為) checking and calculation for treatment acts (処置), including automatic addition of time-based surcharges (時間加算), age-based surcharges (年齢加算), oxygen correction rates (酸素補正率), and narcotic/biological preparation flags. It is called with a mode flag (KBN) to perform per-item checks, whole-claim checks, or automatic calculation.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-based parameter areas (MCPAREA, ORCSC00AREA, COMMON-SPA)
Japanese comments and variable names (mixed Japanese/romaji)
Automatic surcharge insertion logic (時間加算, 年齢加算, 酸素補正率)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed format source with max line length ~74
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 824 lines. Program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source Japanese medical billing system, likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. The filename prefix ORCSC402 and program ID ORCSC40200203 follow ORCA naming conventions for medical procedure calculation subprograms.
